lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor thirty-eight. A hundred and six megawatts. Standard hold.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Control, there are tracks on the approach. Boot tread, not ours.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Boot tread. Two sizes. And a ration wrapper, printed, in a language I can read.
lines.beat: the reveal is a wrapper, not a firefight

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Months old. There's dust settled in the tread and the dust here settles slowly.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Log it and hold the anchor.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Somebody stood exactly where you're standing and did exactly this.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Not here. That's the part I'd think about.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Their emplacement mounts are still bolted in. They took the guns and left the brackets.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: That's a withdrawal, not a rout. Somebody packed.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Bus is over. You know the cost by now.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Losing the ring. Cut what isn't shooting.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Anchor's held. Control, I want a name for whoever was here.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Nothing on file for this anchor.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: They were here for months, Vasquez. Somebody filed something.
lines.beat: Sable Reach seeded without being named — the act ends before the answer
